subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by accepting the linked fixed 500-message mitigation, or should closure require a Control UI load-older pagination UX using the existing `chat.history` offset contract?
rationale: Current main already has backend offset support, but Control UI still uses a fixed initial request; choosing a larger fixed window versus pagination is a UX/performance tradeoff that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can request and prepend older history pages while preserving bounded startup cost.

options.title: Accept fixed-limit mitigation after proof
options.body: Let the linked PR close this issue if maintainers intentionally accept a larger startup request and real browser proof shows acceptable behavior.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can request and prepend older history pages while preserving bounded startup cost.

likelyOwner.reason: The current split Control UI chat-history files and line blame route through shakkernerd's recent PR, making them the strongest current-code routing candidate from local provenance.
